articles.summary: NEW YORK --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Apr. 27, 2026-- Due to a scheduling conflict, Colgate-Palmolive Company (NYSE:CL) will now provide a live webcast of its 2026 first quarter earnings conference call on Friday, May 1, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. ET (previously 8:30 a.m. ET).
articles.title: Colgate-Palmolive Announces Webcast of its 2026 First Quarter Earnings Conference Call May 1, 2026 - Now at 8:00 a.m. ET and its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders on May 8, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. ET
